english.title: Cause / authorise appearance on internet a website where registered society's charitable status does not appear

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: cooperative and community benefit societies act 2014

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[an officer]_
(B)_[a person acting on behalf]_

of a charitable registered society, whose registered name, **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE CHARITABLE REGISTERED SOCIETY..), did not include the word "charity" or "charitable",

(C)_[caused]_
(D)_[authorised]_

the appearance on the internet of a website within section 12(1)(f) of the Co-operative and Community Benefit Societies Act 2014, namely **(..SPECIFY THE WEBSITE..), which did not state in it the fact that it was a charity in legible characters
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(4)(d) of the Co-operative and Community Benefit Societies Act 2014.

english.notes:
(i) Section 12(1) sets out the type of documents and websites that apply to this offence.
(ii) Section 12(2) and (3) sets out the situation for Welsh documents and websites.
(iii) Section 12(5) provides that a person convicted of an offence under subsection (4) by virtue of subsection (4)(b) is also personally liable to the holder of the document for the amount specified in the document unless that amount is duly paid by the society.
